taxonomyProposals.name: No Subscription
taxonomyProposals.description: The named edition supports the stated meaningful core workflow without a mandatory recurring software payment. Free and perpetual paid editions may qualify; trials do not. Optional sync, AI, cloud, maintenance and paid upgrades must be disclosed.
taxonomyProposals.requiredEvidence: Official pricing or license terms identifying edition, usable workflow, recurring requirements and restrictions. A free download badge alone is insufficient.

taxonomyProposals.name: One-Time Purchase
taxonomyProposals.description: An available paid non-recurring license permits continued use of the stated core workflow in the purchased edition/version. Free products, subscriptions, introductory periods and vague lifetime offers do not alone qualify.
taxonomyProposals.requiredEvidence: Official purchase/license terms including version, devices, maintenance, future upgrades and any mandatory recurring services.

taxonomyProposals.name: Privacy-Friendly
taxonomyProposals.description: For the stated writing workflow and edition, official documentation establishes local/self-hosted text processing or another explicitly reviewed data-handling basis. This is a scoped editorial classification, not a security certification or comparative privacy guarantee.
taxonomyProposals.requiredEvidence: Document text transmission, processing location, retention, training use and third-party processing. Default cloud mode and optional AI must be considered separately. Open source or no-account use alone is insufficient.

taxonomyProposals.name: Adobe Photoshop
taxonomyProposals.description: Raster image editing workflows; candidates require a documented overlapping workflow and explicit limitations, without claiming complete Photoshop parity.

taxonomyProposals.name: Productivity Users
taxonomyProposals.description: People using the named edition for documented task planning, note organization or document work. Membership requires workflow evidence; the product's marketing category alone is insufficient.

Audit the exact local/cloud editions, text processing, retention, AI and training policies. No shortlisted product has been approved for this classification.
Verify current perpetual offers, core feature limits, AI quotas, updates and alternative relationships. Expiring or historical lifetime promotions do not suffice.
Existing 30-product fixture has no raster-editing ecosystem. Research at least three new products and overlapping editing workflows before adding memberships.
Separate PDF page operations, annotation and existing-text editing; verify paid/free edition scope and trade-offs before calling a product an editor alternative.
Confirm meaningful free meditation content, platform/account requirements and dated trade-offs. App source claims do not establish therapeutic efficacy.
Verify paid perpetual edition plus documented productivity workflow. Each platform/version and optional recurring service must be explicit.
